sanskrit: vāraṇārṇaṃ sudhābījaṃ kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi camāraḥ pradyumnakandarpāvanṛtānyaparāṇi cacārvaṅgyapi ca carmāṇamasatyānyaparāṇi caśakterbījāni catvāri kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi caaparāṇi hyasatyāni mayā proktāni pārvativiparītatayā proktā vidyā śrīṣoḍaśākṣarīdaśavidyāḥ svayaṃ caitā bhāṣitāḥ kṛttivāsasāetā daśaiva ṣaḍanyā yojitā ṣoḍaśākṣarīdakṣiṇākālikā śyāmā kālarātryapi sundaribrahmādidaivataiḥ pūjyā vidyā śrīṣoḍaśākṣarīkṣāmā śaṅkāpi nīraṃ tadante proktaṃ śiṣyottamajalaṃ bījāni proktāni ṣaḍ asatyānyaparāṇi cabījaṃ pañcaśiro jñeyam ante jñeyaṃ nama itianyāni kṛtrimāṇyeva surāsura-namaskṛtekūrcaṃ caiva maheśāni hyante phaṭ ṭha-dvayaṃ tathāhrāṃ-bījoddhāram etaddhi cānyad anṛtam āvadetlambhāpi lalanā lājā hyasatyānyaparāṇi cakūrcaṃ kūlaṃ taṭaṃ tīram asatyānyaparāṇi caphaṭ haraṃ turagaṃ cānyad asatyaṃ tu sureśvariprokto'yaṃ bhuvaneśvaryā manus turyākṣarābhidhaḥbījānyetāni mantrasya kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi cacārukaṃ rasabījāni hyādau proktāni śaṃbhunāvāsanā paṅkajaṃ caiva vanaṃ proktaṃ tu śūlinākrīṃ-bījāni ca hyetāni kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi caprīṃ-bījāni tu proktāni hyasatyānyaparāṇi tu
source_edition: Muktabodha M00247 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: catuṣṭayaṃ ca chrīṃ-bījamasatyānyaparāṇi capañca ṭhakāra-bījāni hyanṛtānyaparāṇi caante stambhaṃ ca vijñeyaṃ śārikā-mūlam uttamamhrāṃ-bījāni ca catvāri kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi caasatyam aparaṃ jñeyaṃ tārābhaktisamanvitaanṛtam aparaṃ jñeyaṃ parvateśvara-nandinibījaṃ ca ṣaṭśiro jñeyaṃ tataḥ pallavam uddharetebhiḥ saha manuḥ prokto rājñyāḥ pañcadaśākṣaraḥraṃ-bījoddhāram etad dhi kṛtrimamaparaṃ smṛtamviyacchaktyagni-bījāni saṃyojya vāgbhavaṃ tathāṭha-dvayena samāyuktaḥ prokto viṃśākṣaro manuḥbījaṃ ṣaḍakṣaraṃ devyā jvālāmukhyāḥ sureśvarietāsāṃ daśavidyānāṃ guṇān vakṣyāmi tvaṃ śṛṇuvidyāṃ dadāti vāgdevī pratyekaṃ janmaniścalāmśārikā śaṃ dadātyeva rājñī rājyaṃ prayacchatidhanaṃ jvālāmukhī devī bhaktebhyaḥ sā prayacchatiprayacchanti mahā-devi pūjāhoma japādibhiḥiti śrīdakṣiṇāmūrti viracita uddhārakośe sarvāgamārṇave daśavidyā mantroddhārakośa guṇākhyānaṃ nāma prathamaḥ kalpaḥṣaṭsakhībhirahaṃ tāsāṃ mantroddhāraṃ bravīmi teśrotum icchāmyahaṃ mantrān sarvāṃśca mukti-hetavedakṣiṇākālikā śyāmā kālarātrīti sundariṣaṭsakhīnām ahaṃ tāsāṃ mantroddhāraṃ bravīmi teṭha-dvayena samāyukto bhadrakālī mahāmanuḥanṛtamaparaṃ jñeyaṃ brahmānvaya samudbhavaturyā mūlamidaṃ proktaṃ svatantre śaṃbhunā smṛtam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00247 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ṛkṣaṃ bhaṃ tārakā jyotistārā bījāni pañca caanta ucchūna-bījaṃ ca phaṭ ṭhadvaya samāyutamvajravairocanīye dve māye phaṭ svāhayā yutedakṣiṇe kāliketyevam ante kālī trayaṃ punaḥdakṣiṇākālikāyāśca manurdvāviṃśad akṣaraḥamṛtaṃ srāvaya svāhā śyāmā mantramudāhṛtambījaṃ pañcaśiro jñeyaṃ tataḥ pallavam uddharetgaṇeśvaryai tathā cānte viśvaṃ ca samudāhṛtamdeveśi tripurā-vālaṃ vijñeyaṃ dvādaśātmakamkevalaṃ muktaye devi yat proktaṃ tacchubhaṃ smṛtamparaṃ yat sūcitaṃ devi sadyo mukti pradaṃ smṛtamaṣṭabhirdivasairvāpi jānīyān muktilakṣaṇamlakṣmīśca rukmiṇī caiva tribhirvarṣaiḥ phalaṃ labhetbhedāste te tu vikhyātāḥ phalaṃ varṣacatuṣṭayetārā bhedāstu pañcaivamakṣobhyena prakāśitāḥbhaktyā phalapradā devī nityaṃ varṣacatuṣṭayedevyā bhedāstu catvāraḥ phalaṃ varṣacatuṣṭayeśārikāpi tathāparṇā phaladāpi dvivarṣakedvivarṣamadhye bhaktyā ca rājñī rājyaṃ prayacchatibheḍā bhedavihīnā ca prajābhāgyavivardhinīyatheṣṭaphaladaṃ proktaṃ jvālābhedatrayam idametāsāṃ daśavidyānāṃ nānābhedamudāhṛtamcāmuṇḍā nārasiṃhī ca hyaindrī haimavatīśvarīdevyā dvādaśa bhedāstu proktā hyete triśūlināoṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ hiṅgule tathaiva kamalā kṣāmāa tryakṣaṃ caṇḍike
source_edition: Muktabodha M00247 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: hyaindri ? cāraṇameva hrīṃ ca madanaḥ kāmaṃ parā rukmiṇīcandro vāruṇi vā ka e ī la parā durge smṛtā śaṃbhunāvidyā śrī viparīta bhāva sahitā syāt ṣoḍaśātmā vidhiḥbhedairyutānāṃ devīnāṃ manuṃ tvaṃ vaktum arhasidayayā tava deveśi tad vakṣyāmi samāsataḥtryakṣaṃ hrīṃ śaktinīramante proktamapi dhūrjaṭināante proktaṃ maheśāni lakṣmyā bhedadvayamidamvāgdevatāyāḥ phaladaṃ hi vālaṃ nṛṇāṃ namo bhaktiparāyaṇānāmtāraṃ lajjordhvabījaṃ ca hyante stambham udāhṛtamnamo'nte parameśāni mayā proktaṃ nagātmajetryakṣaṃ viśvaṃ tathānte ca parvateśvara nandinidevyā bhedāstu catvāraḥ sarasvatyā varānaneetāsāṃ daśavidyānāmanyāsāṃ śṛṇu vacmyahambhadrakālī yathā devī dakṣiṇākālikā tathāturī bheda vihīnāsti yatheṣṭa phaladāyinīetā bhedavihīnāśca yathā kāmaphalapradāḥmantroddhārakośa bhedasūcakonāma dvitīyaḥ kalpaḥśṛṇuṣvaikāgra-manasā bravīmi tvatkutūhalātbhāṣitā ṣoḍaśī vidyā nanandākṣobhyako muniḥāyayurmunayassarve sotsukā mantrakāṅkṣiṇaḥśāṇḍilyagālavau caivam ete tasyāśramaṃ yayuḥparasparaṃ vai svakuleṣṭa devī mantrāṃśca vandyān śubhadān papracchuḥcarācare'smin jagati devī tripurasundarītasyāśca vadanāmbhojāt sapta devyaḥ śrutā mayāacireṇaiva kālena phaladāstan-mukhācchrutāḥ

sanskrit: prasādaṃ kuru viprarṣe cedasmāsu dayā tavayena śravaṇamātreṇa hayamedhaphalaṃ labhetsapta vidyāḥ purā proktā vajrayoginyādi devatāḥdakṣiṇāmūrtinā devi prakāśitāni ca tattvataḥkulavāgīśvarī hyetāḥ sapta devyaḥ śrutā mayāetāsāṃ balam āśritya devī tripurasundarīharate'pi tathā viśvaṃ carācarasamanvitametāsāṃ mantrāṇi vakṣyāmi śṛṇudhvaṃ munipuṃgavāḥmadhye'pi vajrayoginyai hyante nīramudāhṛtamsa nirjitya ripūn sarvān kalyāṇī gṛham āviśetdvādaśa divasāṃstāvat siddhirbhavati vāñchitāṛtu snātāyā bhāryāyā maithunaṃ kurute naraḥlikhitvā dhārayen mūrdhni trailokya vijayī bhavetaoddharauvaneśaryai arāṇi cakāntāyā maithunaṃ kuryāt bahuputrayuto bhavetyāvajjanma bhavet tasya tāvacchatrurna jīvatiyāvajjanma bhavet tasya tāvallakṣmīrbhaviṣyatianuvāde sa śatrūṇāṃ vākyajñaḥ sahasā bhavetphalam etan mahāścarya kārakaṃ munipuṃgavāḥvāgbhavaṃ sauṣmakaṃ caiva tataḥ pallavamuddharetvarāhamukhi caivaṃ tu vāsanā ca maṭhaṃ tathābhagavatyāśca vārāhyā ekatriṃśākṣaro manuḥglauṃ bījoddhāram etaddhi cānyad anṛtam āvadetlaṃ bījoddhārāṇyetāni kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi cabhagavatyai śāradāyai cānte lajjā ca ṭhadvayam

sanskrit: madanam ūrmidhvāntau dvau saṃyojya stanabījakamjṛmbanākhye tato devi kāmeśvari tathaiva cakāmeśvaryā mahādevyā dvāviṃśadakṣaro manuḥtārādhipaḥ sudhāraśmiḥ kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi cabaṃ-bījoddhārāṇyetāni kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi cajaṃbījānyevam etāni kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi cabhagavatyā mahāgauryā vālastu dvādaśākṣaraḥgaṃbījāni ca catvāri kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi caannapūrṇe ṭhadvayaṃ ca manurviṃśākṣaraḥ smṛtaḥbījaṃ tu ṣaṭśiro jñeyaṃ viśvena saha bhāminitaṭaṃ caivamicchābījaṃ tataḥ pallavam uddharetante ca vāsanābījaṃ padmaṃ kāṅkṣāpi nīrajamkulavāgīśvarī devyāsturyaviṃśākṣaro manuḥjhaṃbījānyevam etāni kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi capaṇyastrī pañcabījāni strīṃbījasyānṛtaṃ paramvada me satvaraṃ devi tad vakṣyāmi suvistaramkṛpayāpi purā mahyaṃ sūcitā na prakāśitāḥmanūn pañca kumārāṇām asmākaṃ vaktumarhasidakṣiṇāmūrtinoktaṃ yat tat te vakṣyāmi tattvataḥhanumadbhairavāvete bhāṣitāḥ pañcabālakāḥsvayaṃ mayā ca tantroktā bhāṣitāḥ ṣaṭkumārakāḥyāmale rudraśabdādau bhāṣitāḥ sapta bālakāḥśaṃkaraṃ ṣaṭśiro mantraṃ tataḥ pallavamuddharetante'pi ṭhadvayaṃ jñeyamaṣṭāviṃśākṣaro manuḥmadhye kumārāya namo hyante nīram udāhṛtam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00247 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: hāṃbījāni ca catvāri kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi caśukrabījaṃ tathā śūnyaṃ kamalā rasanā tathāante payo manuḥ prokta ekaviṃśākṣaraḥ śivevroṃbījāni tu pañcaiva kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi cahanumate tataḥ paścād rāmadūtāya vai punaḥbhūtāya śākinī caiva ḍākinī tadanantaramvibhīṣaṇāya hanumaddevāya tadanantaramharam āpastathānte'pi saptaṣaṣṭyakṣaro manuḥabdhibījaṃ kalpabījaṃ śataghnī bījasaṃyutamante'po bhairavasyāyaṃ manuraṣṭādaśākṣaraḥvīṃ bījāni ca pañcaivam anṛtānyaparāṇi caruṃbījāni ca catvāri kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi cadhruṃ bījānyevam aṣṭau ca kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi caghnīṃ bījāni tu pañcaivam asatyānyaparāṇi catasmācchaktiḥ khaṃ śarad dhṛjjatrāsau mantroddhāro devi mṛtyuṃjayasyakālī padmau kūrca padmau samastā padmau nīram eṣa sugrīvamantraḥmayākhyātāḥ sureśāni hyete vai saptabālakāḥbravīmi bhavatāṃ prītyā ājñāpayitumarhathakośākhyānaṃ nāma tṛtīyaḥ kalpaḥnavagrahāṇām asmākaṃ manūṃstvaṃ vaktumarhasinavagrahāṇāṃ mantrāśca tān vakṣyāmi samāsataḥete pañca maheśāni pañceṣorvāṇa devatāḥdevasya khaṇḍa paraśorlocanatrayadevatāḥete navagrahāḥ proktāḥ śaṃbhunā rudrayāmalebījaṃ turyaśiro jñeyaṃ tataḥ pallavam uddharet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00247 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ante payastu vijñeyaṃ manurdvayaṣṭākṣaraḥ smṛtaḥhmauḥ bījāni ṣaḍdevi kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi cabudhasya grahanāthasya manuścaturdaśākṣaraḥṅa bījāni ca saptaivam asatyānyaparāṇi caśukrāyānte'śmarī caiva vālaścaturdaśākṣaraḥtaraṅga veśye saṃyojya cārvaṅgī hiṅgubījakamtato grahādhipataye bṛhaspataya eva cavāsanā paṅkajaṃ caivam ante proktaṃ vanaṃ śivekva rukmiṇī kva saubhāgyaṃ dyaubhuvorantaraṃ mahatpraṇavaṃ sakalā caiva deveśi rukmiṇī tathācandro maṭhaṃ tataḥ paścād grahādhipataye tataḥante nīraṃ samākhyātaṃ pañcaviṃśākṣaro manuḥnāṭyabījaṃ tato madhye candrāyānte'śmarī smṛtācaṃ bījāni ca catvāri kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi caete vai pañcavāṇānāṃ grahāḥ pañcaprakīrtitāḥbhaumāyānte payaḥ prokto manuḥ pañcadaśākṣaraḥkaṃ bījānyapi catvāri kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi cagraha-cakravartine'pi śanaiścarāya vai tataḥśanaiścarasya deveśi manurviṃśākṣaraḥ smṛtaḥtataṣ ṭaṅkadhāriṇe ca rāhave havyavāhanaḥrāhorviṃśākṣaro vālo yathābhīṣṭa phalapradaḥṭaṃbījāni ca catvāri kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi casudine sādhako mantrān grahāṇāṃ sādhayecchiveketorayaṃ mahāmantro devi pañcadaśākṣaraḥkrūṃ bījāni ca catvāri kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00247 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: adyāhaṃ tava deveśi varṇānāṃ vacmi vai manūnyena vijñānamātreṇa māntrikaḥ sādhako bhavetnavagrahamantroddhārakośākhyānaṃ nāma caturthaḥ kalpaḥprasanno'si mahābhāginnasmāsu kṛpayā prabhovarṇānāṃ śrotum icchāmo mantra-kośāni vai vayamvarṇānāṃ mantrakośaṃ ca nissṛtaṃ tripurāmukhātmunīnāṃ sūcitaṃ yacca dakṣiṇāmūrtinā purāaparam anṛtaṃ jñeyam akārasya sureśvari || 5 || || a ||ākārasyānṛtam anyad uktaṃ bhairava-tantrake || 6 || || ā ||mayā proktaṃ sureśāni granthe bhairavatantrake || 7 || || i ||mayā proktaṃ sureśāni tripurātilake śive || 8 || || ī ||mayākhyātāni sarvasve kubjikāyāḥ sureśvari || 9 || || u ||śiromaṇau mayā proktaṃ sundaryāḥ parameśvari || 10 || || ū ||ṛkārasya rahasye'smin kālyāḥ proktaṃ mayā śive || 11 || || ṛ ||ṛkārasyānṛtam anyad bhāṣitaṃ viśvayāmale || 12 || || ṝ ||ḷkārasyānṛtam anyad uktaṃ ca rudrayāmale || 13 || || ḷ ||granthe ca svakṛtau devi mantrasāgaratantrake || 14 || || ḹ ||allībījaṃ ca vārākī cānyad anṛtam āvadetkulacūḍāmaṇau granthe racite māntrikottamaiḥ || 16 || || e ||candro'pi carmavasanaṃ vāsanā ca tathaiva catripurāsarvasve granthe dakṣiṇāmūrtinā kṛte || 18 || || ai ||chinnāśiromaṇau granthe racite'pi mayā svayam || 19 || || o ||āgastyaṃ ca mayākhyātaṃ granthe bhairavatantrake || 20 || || au ||siddhasārasvate granthe brahmaṇaiva prakāśite || 21 || || aṃ ||granthe tripurasundaryāḥ sarvasve viśvadurlabhe || 22 || || aḥ ||
source_edition: Muktabodha M00247 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vedhobījaṃ vidhirbrahmā svayaṃbhūbījameva cagranthe chinnārahasye'smin parvateśvaranandini || 24 || || ka ||āgamāmṛtamañjaryāṃ durlabhāyāṃ mamāpi ca || 25 || || kha ||kulacūḍāmaṇau granthe durlabhe tridive'pi ca || 26 || || ga ||ghakārasya mayākhyātaṃ granthe vai rudrayāmale || 27 || || gha ||kubjikāsarvasve khyātaṃ mayā trailokyapūjite || 28 || || ṅa ||cakārasya mayā khyātaṃ granthe bhairava-tantrake || 29 || || ca ||chaṃbījaṃ ca mayā proktaṃ granthe vāmakeśvare śive || 30 || || cha ||āgamālaṃkaraṇe'pi granthe bhairavanirmite || 31 || || ja ||trailokya prathite granthe devi vai vāmakeśvare || 32 || || jha ||tripurāsarvasve granthe trijagaddurlabhe priye || 33 || || ña ||ṭakārasya mayākhyātaṃ svatantre devavandite || 34 || || ṭa ||mayākhyātāni deveśi tantre vai vāmakeśvare || 35 || || ṭha ||ḍakārasya mayā devi granthe vai rudrayāmale || 36 || || ḍa ||ḍhakārasya mayākhyātamanyad anṛtam āvadet || 37 || || ḍha ||ṇakārasyānṛtam anyad granthe bhairavatantrake || 38 || || ṇa ||kubjikāsarvasve granthe taṃbījaṃ ca mayā smṛtam || 39 || || ta ||thakārasya mayākhyātaṃ tantre vai kulikārṇave || 40 || || tha ||bhogibījaṃ bhujaṅgaṃ ca bhujaṅgamamiti smṛtamsvatantre devadeveśi dakṣiṇāmūrtinā kṛte || 42 || || da ||dhakārasyānṛtam anyat tripurātilakaṃ smṛtam || 43 || || dha ||trailokya prathite granthe tripurāyāḥ śiromaṇau || 44 || || na ||jhaṣabījaṃ mayākhyātaṃ granthe chinnāśiromaṇaubhāṣaṇoddhāraviṣaye likhane prakṛtiḥ pṛthak || 46 || || pa ||śāradāpaṭale granthe trailokyaprathite śive || 47 || || pha ||
source_edition: Muktabodha M00247 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kālikāsarvasve granthe brahmaṇaiva prakāśite || 48 || || ba ||tantre vai muṇḍamālāyāṃ mayākhyātaṃ sureśvari || 49 || || bha ||āgamāmṛtamañjaryāṃ parvateśvara nandini || 50 || || ma ||vīrā śārṇaṃ tathā vāpī mayākhyātaṃ svatantrake || 51 || || ya ||rakārasya mayākhyātaṃ śyāmātantre sureśvari || 52 || || ra ||lakārasya mayākhyātaṃ svatantre muninirmite || 53 || || la ||bhūbījaṃ dharaṇībījaṃ vakāraṃ bhāṣitaṃ mayā || 54 || || va ||śakārasya mayākhyātaṃ granthe bhairavatantrake || 55 || || śa ||mayākhyātaṃ sureśāni granthe vai rudrayāmale || 56 || || ṣa ||sakārasya mayākhyātaṃ granthe chinnāśiromaṇau || 57 || || sa ||siddhasārasvate granthe nityaṃ māntrikapūjite || 58 || || ha ||kṣakārasya mayā proktaṃ kulacūḍāmaṇau priye || 59 || || kṣa ||nānāmantrayutaṃ devi sarvāgama viniścitamkośākhyānaṃ nāma pañcamaḥ kalpaḥpṛthaṅnāma sureśāni sakalāgama niścitamdakṣiṇāmūrtinā pūrvam ṛṣīṇāṃ bhāṣitāḥ svayamindrākṣyapi tṛtīyā ca tisro bhuvana devatāḥyasya kasya na vaktavyaṃ na vaktavyaṃ varānanehariṇākṣīdvayaṃ kūrcaṃ haraṃ ṭhadvayasaṃyutammantraṃ ca dviśiro jñeyaṃ tataḥ pallavam uddharettathāpi sarvaduṣṭānāṃ vācaṃ mukhaṃ padaṃ tathātryakṣam ante payo jñeyaṃ dvipañcāśākṣaro manuḥmṛtsnānṛtaṃ paraṃ jñeyaṃ parvateśvara nandiniprasthabījaṃ parāṃ padmāṃ carmāṇaṃ ca tato'bhidhamindrākṣyā devadevyāśca hyaṣṭāviṃśākṣaro manuḥ

sanskrit: mlauṃ bījoddhāram etaddhi cānyad anṛtam āvadetdakṣiṇāmūrtinā bhaktyā saṃsāre'smin prakāśitāḥyām āśritya labhed yogī khecarīṃ siddhidāṃ kalāmtamobījaṃ tato dadyān māyābījaṃ tataḥ paramkhecaryai ca tato dadyād ante sauṣmakam eva caetāsāṃ devatānāṃ ca grahāṇāṃ devavanditetathā bhedavihīnānāṃ śṛṇu pārvati tattvataḥkośākhyānaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭhaḥ kalpaḥvāmakeśvara tantroktaṃ tripurāyāḥ sureśvarisudhāṃśu mukuṭāṃ hima saṃnibhābhāmbrahmendra viṣṇunamitāṃ tripurāṃ bhaje'hammunisādhaka gīrvāṇa vipravargaiḥ supūjiteudyadbhāsvat kanakaruciṃ padmaśaṅkhāsi pāṇimnityaṃ lokatritaya phaladāṃ naumyahaṃ bhaktipūrvamtantramuktāvalau granthe durlabhe tridive'pi cacandrārdhāṅkita mastakāṃ nijakaraiḥ saṃbibhratīmādarātdivyair ābharaṇairvibhūṣita tanuṃ siṃhādhirūḍhāṃ bhajedevyā bhedavihīnāyā munisādhaka pūjitemuktāratna parītakaṇṭhavalayāṃ raktāmbarāṃ vibhratīmnityaṃ lokatrayaika rakṣaṇaparāṃ tārāṃ trinetrāṃ bhajesādhakeṣṭa prade granthe niḥsmṛtaṃ rudrayāmaledorbhir aṅkuśapāśapustakajayān saṃbibhratīṃ sādarātstotrādyairbhuvaneśvarīṃ trinayanāṃ hṛtpaṅkaje'haṃ bhajekubjikāsarvasve granthe mamāpyatyanta durlabhenānāratna sahasra baddharasanāṃ pretāsane saṃsthitām

sanskrit: dhyāye'haṃ hṛdaye sadā bhagavatīṃ mātaṅginīṃ hāriṇīmāgamāmṛtamañjaryāṃ niḥsmṛtaṃ durlabhaṃ janaiḥnāgendra hāravalayāṅkita kaṇṭhamālāmśrīśārikāṃ tri-nayanāṃ hṛdaye smarāmivāmakeśvara tantroktaṃ parvateśvara nandinicaturbhujām eṇa tvag āsanasthāmrājñīṃ bhaje'haṃ tuhinādri rūpāmniḥsmṛtam āgamoddyote mayā viracite svayamphulla padmopaviṣṭāṃ vīṇā nāgendra śaṅkhāmmuktā hārāṃśu nānāmaṇiyuta hṛdayāmprahasita vadanāṃ sādhakeṣṭa pradātrīmdhyānaṃ mayā viracite granthe jvālāśiromaṇausiṃhāsane sthāpita pādayugmāṃ jvālāmukhīṃ suhṛdaye smarāmisvayaṃ mayā viracite tantre vai vāmakeśvarenāhaṃ tṛptā vadantīṃ sakalajana cayaṃ bhakṣayantīṃ sadaivadhyāye'haṃ bhadrakālīṃ navajalaviṣadāṃ pretamadhyāsanasthāmasmiṃścarācare khyāte brahmaṇaiva prakāśitepāśāmbhojadharāṃ himāṃśu dhavalāṃ dorbhyāṃ dvibāhuṃ śivāmbrahmā viṣṇu maheśvaraiśca namitāṃ devīṃ bhaje'haṃ turīmsvakṛte tripurāyāśca granthe devi śiromaṇaujvālābaddha mahārgha ratnanicayāṃ kandarpa darpojjvalāmbhakteṣṭāṃ chinnamastakāṃ bhagavatīṃ dhyāye hṛdabje sadāgranthe kālīrahasye'smin parvateśvara nandinivarṣāmegha nibhāṃ triśūla musalau padmāsi pāśāṅkuśāndevīṃ dakṣiṇakālikāṃ bhagavatīṃ raktāmbarāṃ tāṃ smare
source_edition: Muktabodha M00247 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śyāmā tantre mayākhyātaṃ sakalāgama sāgarekṛṣṇāmbubhṛt sadṛśa rūpadharāṃ trinetrāmśyāmāṃbhaje śavaśarīra kṛtāsanasthāmmayā viracite devi tantre vai vāmakeśvaresiṃhāsanasthāṃ dhṛta pītavastrāṃ dhyāye maheśīṃ hṛdi kālarātrīmśrīvajrayoginī dhyānaṃ niḥsmṛtaṃ kulikārṇavedvibhujāṃ siṃham adhyasthāṃbhaje'haṃ vajrayoginīmyathābhīṣṭa pradaṃ devi kulacūḍāmaṇau priyesūryāgni candrīkṛta dṛṣṭi pātāṃ dhyāye hṛdabje vimalāṃ varāhīmśāradāpaṭale granthe racite'pi mayā svayamparvate sthitavatīṃ dhṛtaśūlāṃ śāradāṃ bhagavatīṃ hṛdi dhyāyekāmeśvaryāstripurāyāḥ sarvasve tantrakottamepītāmbarāṃ viṣṇu maheśa sevyāṃ kāmeśvarīṃ tāṃ hṛdaye smarāmigranthe mayā viracite parvateśvara nandinicandrodbhāsita śekharāṃ smitamukhīṃ dorbhyāṃ vahantīṃ gadāmgaurīṃ mānasa paṅkajāṃ bhagavatīṃ bhakteṣṭadāṃ tāṃ bhajeniḥsmṛtaṃ bhairave tantre mayā devi prakāśiteeṇāsanasthāṃ bhujagopavītāṃ tām annapūrṇāṃ hṛdaye smarāmiāgamāmṛtamañjaryāṃ durlabhāyāṃ mamāpi catryakṣāṃ siṃhāsanagatāṃ kulavāgīśvarīṃ bhajeāgamārṇavapīpūṣe durlabhe bhuvane'mbikedvimṛgādhipa gāminaṃ trinetraṃ śivaputraṃ dviradānanaṃ bhaje'hamniḥsmṛtam āgamoddyote mayā viracite śivenāgendra kanyā priyaputram ādyaṃ hṛdi smare'bhīṣṭapradaṃ kumāramyathābhīṣṭa pradaṃ nṛṇām uḍḍāmara viniścitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00247 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: himāṃśu sadṛśānanaṃ dhṛtasahasra tūṇīrakamsmarāmi bhuvanādhipaṃ hṛdi tu kārtavīryārjunammṛtyuṃjayasya devasya granthe kubjāśiromaṇauhastābjena sudhāṃśu koṭi vimalaṃ hāsyasya paṅkeruhammbhojān bibhratam akṣayaṃ paśupatiṃ mṛtyuṃjayaṃ taṃ smarekulacūḍāmaṇau granthe nirmite mantrasāgaredorbhirvṛkṣagadā dhanuḥ śaracayān saṃbibhrataṃ sādarātdhyāye'haṃ bhagavantam arkatanayaṃ sugrīvadevaṃ hṛdikulacūḍāmaṇau granthe parvateśvara nandinisumeru śṛṅgābham acintyam ādyaṃ hṛdi smare'haṃ hanumantam īḍyamniḥsmṛtaṃ bhairave tantre yathābhīṣṭa phalapradamacintyam ādyaṃ madhupāna saktaṃ hṛdi smare bhairavam iṣṭadaṃ tamtripurāsarvasve granthe dakṣiṇāmūrtinā kṛtesaptāśvagaṃ saddhvajahastam ādyaṃ devaṃ bhaje'haṃ mihiraṃ hṛdabjeyathā bhīṣṭa pradaṃ satyaṃ surāsura namaskṛtedayānidhiṃ bhūṣaṇabhūṣitāṅgaṃ budhaṃ smare mānasapaṅkaje'hamkubjikāsarvasve granthe brahmaṇaiva prakāśitekrauṃcāsanaṃ ca sura sevita pādapadmaṃ śukraṃ smaredvijayanaṃ hṛdayāmbuje'hamdhyānaṃ bhairavatantroktaṃ sakalārtha pradaṃ nṛṇāmmedhā nidhiṃ matsyagataṃ ? dvi-bāhuṃ guruṃ smare mānasapaṅkaje'hamniḥsmṛtam āgamoddyote nānā dhyāna saritpatautamīpatim ambuja yugma hastaṃ dhyāye hṛdabje śaśinaṃ graheśamāgamāmṛtamañjaryāṃ śṛṇuṣvaika manāḥ priyesurāsuraiḥ pūjita pādapadmaṃ bhaumaṃ dayāluṃ hṛdaye smarāminiḥsmṛtaṃ ca maheśāni śubhadam āgamāmṛte
source_edition: Muktabodha M00247 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: surāsurāṇāṃ bhayadaṃ dvibāhuṃ smare śaniṃ mānasapaṅkaje'hamniḥsmṛtaṃ phaladaṃ nṛṇāṃ tantre vai vāmakeśvaretrailokya rakṣā param iṣṭadaṃ ca rāhuṃ grahendraṃ hṛdaye bhaje'hamniḥsmṛtaṃ āgamoddyote granthe vai mantrasāgarekṛṣṇāmbaraṃ śakti triśūlahastaṃ ketuṃ bhaje mānasapaṅkaje'hamkulacūḍāmaṇau granthe niḥsmṛtaṃ bhuvaneśvaribhayadāṃ mahiṣottamāṅga saṃsthāṃ navadūrvā sadṛśīṃ bhaje bhavānīmāgamāmṛtamañjaryāṃ surāsura namaskṛtegharmāṃśvagni śaśāṅkaraśmi nayanāṃ siṃhāsanasthāṃ śivāmdevīṃ śrībagalāmukhīṃ hṛdi bhaje bhakteṣṭadāṃ muktidāmniḥsmṛtaṃ jagad īśāni granthe vai rudrayāmalemattairāvaṇa pṛṣṭhagāṃ śaśimukhīṃ trailokyarakṣāparāmindrākṣīṃ janamātaraṃ hṛdi bhaje kāruṇyarūpāṃ parāmgranthe bhairavatantrākhye niḥsmṛta tridaśārcitesitāsita karānanāṃ sitakarojjvala śekharāmsmarāmi hṛdi khecarīṃ bhuvanamātaraṃ siddhidāmyasya kasya na dātavyaṃ grantham uddhārakośakamjayatvaṃ svagṛhaṃ gantum ājñāpayitumarhasiityuktā munayo jagmuḥ svagṛhaṃ mantralālasāḥkṛtam uddhārakośākhyaṃ granthaṃ gopyatamaṃ kuruubhau tāvambikā devī devaśca candraśekharaḥsapta kumāra nava graha catasṛ devī kośa dhyāna nirṇayo nāma saptamaḥ kalpaḥ
